name: Mohamed Gamal
title: Senior Software Engineer & Odoo / ERP Specialist
subtitle: Enterprise systems · Portals & web · Backend, integrations & data
headline: I build software that connects business workflows to reliable systems — from Odoo and ERP platforms to web applications, backend services, integrations, automation and data pipelines.
about: I'm Mohamed Gamal, a software engineer with 4+ years building systems that go into production. Odoo and ERP is my deepest specialisation — and it sits inside broader engineering work: employee and customer portals, backend services and APIs, integrations, workflow automation and data pipelines.

My approach is business-first: I map the workflow and the requirements before writing a line of code, so the system that ships is both technically sound and genuinely usable by the people in it every day. A data background before ERP is why reporting and performance tend to be the parts clients comment on.

highlights.strong: Built complete ERP systems from scratch
highlights.text: for Margins Developments (Real Estate, Egypt) and DOTec Engineering (USA) — owning the full project from data modeling and module architecture to QWeb reports, automation, and access control.

at EJAD Digital Solutions (Odoo Silver Partner, KSA) and Odoo Developer at EjadTech (KSA) — working on ERP implementations, custom modules, digital transformation projects, and government platform backends.
across custom modules, ORM, QWeb reports, access rights, server actions, cron jobs, automation, REST API integrations, PostgreSQL optimization, and performance tuning — on Odoo 14 through Odoo 19.
requirement analysis, story sizing, and process mapping before coding — ensuring ERP solutions that solve real business problems, not just technical exercises.
